# Ilyra Disappears During Night Inventory

Ilyra signs the night register and enters the Restricted Vault. She does not sign out, and the main vault door is found locked the next morning.

## Author notes

She used the concealed north-shelf stair. The canonical event records disappearance from public view, not death or abduction.
